BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

2. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   B. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   D. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

5. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   D. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   B. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

9. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

13. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   C. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

15. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   C. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
